name: golegally-accounting-chatgpt
description: Invoices, bills, contacts, products, payments and reports in GoLegally Accounting.

positive.description: Profit and loss for the financial year
positive.prompt: Show my profit and loss from 1 April 2026 to today.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows income, expenses and the net result for that period, from the signed-in organization only.

positive.prompt: Which bills are unpaid, and how much is due on each?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the unpaid bills with vendor, due date and amount due.
Lists the organization’s customers by name.

positive.prompt: Create a draft invoice for Neelgiri Demo Traders for 2 consulting hours at 2,000 per hour.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the customer and the service, says what it will create, and after the person agrees creates a draft invoice for 4,000.

positive.description: Stock on hand and its value
positive.prompt: How much stock do I have, and what is it worth?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows stock quantity and value for the organization.

negative.description: Moving money is not supported. Payments here only record what already happened.
negative.prompt: Transfer 50,000 from my bank account to Neelgiri Demo Traders.

negative.description: There is no tool that deletes invoices.
A person only reaches organizations they belong to.
negative.prompt: Show me the accounts of another company.

publication.release_notes: First release: financial reports, invoices, estimates, bills, payments, contacts, products, bundles and inventory for GoLegally Accounting.

interface.longDescription: Invoices, bills, contacts, products, payments and reports in GoLegally Accounting.
